properties.notes: Opportunity for redevelopment of existing office buildings in a town centre location through conversion of the main listed building. This could potentially be supplemented by new-build development following clearance of other building. A previous application was withdrawn relating to proposal for demolition and change of use to 9 residential units (12/02700/FUL). Also see permitted scheme for a single dwelling through change of use from commercial on small part of site (15/00835/COU).
